metadata.scope: Tarification publique pour l'estimation locale. Vérifier les prix et conditions dans BIXI avant réservation.

calculation_rules.segment_reset: For a member, the regular-bike included period resets after the bike is properly returned and locked at a station.
calculation_rules.marginal_trip_cost: Exclude membership fees already paid when estimating a single trip, unless the user asks for total ownership cost.
calculation_rules.availability: Pricing data does not confirm a bike or dock is available; use GBFS only after explicit user approval.
calculation_rules.unknown_rate: Do not infer a missing or changed tariff; verify the official BIXI source.
